body.x: Medical students learn from flat textbook questions that rarely resemble the scans and cases they will face. Practicing inside a real image, or a model you can turn in your hands, is closer to the work.
MediCherry Inc. was named a 2027 Honoree in EdTech at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for MyMerci Clinical Learning Intelligence, a platform for healthcare students and clinicians.

MyMerci Clinical Learning Intelligence is a web and mobile platform for healthcare students and practicing clinicians. Its questions combine exam blueprints, verified items, medical terminology and theory across 18 released interactive formats, and learners answer some items within real CT, MRI or X-ray studies or by rotating a licensed 3D anatomy model. The tutor withholds answers and asks students concept questions, while practitioners receive concise briefings.

Explanations retrieve biomedical literature and display numbered sources with confidence and review status, and before generated content reaches learners, deterministic checks screen for invalid answers and answer cues, independent models assess higher-risk items, and human reviewers control publication.

The same grounding and review pipeline serves Korean, English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese and Vietnamese content, and MyMerci is an educational platform, not a diagnostic, treatment or clinical decision-support tool.

The CES Innovation Awards program, an annual competition honoring outstanding design and engineering in consumer technology products, recognizes all recipients as Honorees at two levels. The Honoree level covers products that score above the scoring threshold in each category, while Best of Innovation goes to the highest-scoring Honorees. A panel of industry expert judges and global media scores each product on engineering and functionality, aesthetic and design, and what makes it unique and innovative.

AVING NEWS, a global media company with 21 years of experience covering CES, operates AVING CES Newsroom (avingces.news), a dedicated platform for delivering the latest innovations to global audiences. Publishing more than 1,000 articles and conducting hundreds of on-site video interviews annually, AVING NEWS has helped Korean startups gain international visibility and expand their global reach. At CES 2027, AVING NEWS will operate the AVING TECH TALK broadcast zone at the Venetian Expo (Hall A, Booth 50271), providing on-site coverage and interviews that spotlight Korean companies and their latest innovations.
